name: agentation
description_en: The visual feedback tool for agents.
readme_excerpt: Agentation is an agent-agnostic visual feedback tool. Click elements on your page, add notes, and copy structured output that helps AI coding agents find the exact code you're referring to. Install Usage The toolbar appears in the bottom-right corner. Click to activate, then click any element to annotate it. Connect to your agent Copied feedback works with Claude Code, Codex, Gemini, Grok, or any AI tool.
